title: Acme POS Quick Recall — Microlearning
objectives: Recall key Acme POS steps and override rules

items.front: When does a refund need a manager override?
items.back: No receipt, above the shift threshold, or voiding after drawer close.

items.front: First step to refund with no receipt?
items.back: Start the refund, then request the manager override when prompted.

items.front: What does the override actually do?
items.back: Adds a second approval check on higher-risk transactions (a financial control).

items.front: Standard refund, valid receipt, under threshold — override needed?
items.back: No — you can complete it yourself.

items.front: Where do you get help mid-shift if the override fails?
items.back: [CONFIRM: support path — e.g. shift lead, then help desk extension].
